title: Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimator under Random Forest
text: Least squares regression can inefficient error distribution far Gaussian, example heavy tails outliers. distributionally adaptive regression estimator (DARE) Dai (2025) estimates conditional mean E[Y∣X=x0]E[Y \mid X = x_0] weighted combination conditional quantiles levels k/(K+1)k/(K+1), k=1,…,Kk = 1, \dots, K. weights adapt unknown error distribution, number quantiles KK chosen cross-validation. regularity conditions DARE attains asymptotic variance infeasible likelihood-based estimator keeping convergence rate conventional estimators. DARERF implements random forest version DARE. Conditional quantiles conditional distribution function target point come quantile regression forest (quantregForest), method works many covariates nonlinear relationships without choosing functional form. Documentation: https://shengtao-dai.github.io/DARERF/

title: Distributionally Adaptive Regression Estimator under Random Forest
code: library(DARERF)  # Simulated data with heavy-tailed (t, 3 df) errors; the true m(0, 0) is 0.5 set.seed(123) n <- 500 X <- cbind(rnorm(n), rnorm(n)) Y <- as.numeric(0.5 + X %*% c(1, -1) + rt(n, df = 3))  rf_eq_estimate(Y, X, x0 = c(0, 0), K_grid = c(1, 3, 5), L = 2, ntr = 500L) #> [1] 0.3428415

title: Distributionally adaptive regression estimator (random forest) — rf_eq_estimate
text: Estimates conditional mean \(m(x_0) = E[Y \mid X = x_0]\) weighted combination quantile regression forest estimates levels \(\tau_k = k / (K + 1)\), \(k = 1, \dots, K\). weights built forest's conditional distribution function around quantile, K chosen K_grid L-fold cross-validation cv_select_K_ml().
